text:
# Read numbers from stdin and print their sum.
import sys

total = 0
for line in sys.stdin:
    # skip blank lines
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    total += int(line)
print(total)

name: bash function
text:
backup() {
  local src="$1" dest="$2"
  if [[ ! -d "$src" ]]; then
    echo "missing: $src" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  tar -czf "$dest/$(date +%F).tar.gz" "$src"
}
